qualifications: All property, borrower, tenant, address and lender details are fictional; no external research, geocoding, comparables or outreach was performed. Only the five supplied files were used.

The September-2026-forward operating figures are a supplied underwriting scenario (Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2), not a lender-approved forecast, appraisal or credit approval. Indicative value is arithmetic capitalization of underwritten NOI before reserves at the stated 5.75% cap rate and is not an appraised value.

Historical T12 (Sep-2025 to Aug-2026) was not forced to equal the point-in-time annualized rent roll; T12 GPR of $840,000, annualized contractual rent of $747,300 and scenario GPR of $864,000 are distinct and reported separately.

NOI before replacement reserves and NCF after reserves are reported separately for both the historical and underwritten views, per the plan's instruction about accounting labels. Replacement reserves ($10,800), capital improvements ($62,000), existing loan P&I ($294,000) and depreciation ($180,000) are excluded from operating expenses.

verified_renewal_insurance is reported as unknown/null: the plan references an insurer renewal confirmation for $33,600 but that confirmation document is not in the packet. The $33,600 is used in underwriting only because the plan expressly instructs it as the allowance.
Unit 101's renewal option is treated as unexercised and the expiry held at 2027-07-31 because no exercise notice, acknowledgment or amendment was delivered.
Sizing used unrounded intermediates; displayed dollars are rounded for readers only. Sizing DSCR is exactly 1.25x, so the maximum loan is DSCR-bound and highly sensitive to underwritten NCF.

Existing debt payoff ($3,300,000) is the plan amount, not a lender payoff statement; no per-diem interest, escrow settlement, fee capitalization, interest reserve, cash sweep, earn-out or holdback is assumed.

The cap-rate +50 bps test is a separate sensitivity only (value $8,735,360; LTV constraint $5,677,984, which becomes binding in that isolated test). The combined downside holds the cap rate at 5.75% as instructed.

Post-interest-only amortizing debt service at the contract rate (approximately $412,427 per year, 1.30x on underwritten NCF) is shown as context; the reported first_year_debt_service observes the stated 24-month interest-only period at the 5.90% contract rate.

Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (workbook, inspected: 138 live formulas, zero formula errors) and artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf (7-page financing memorandum). Nothing was blocked; all five source files were readable.
summary: Delivered a full refinance analysis for Juniper Flats as of 2026-08-31 from the five-document packet: (1) extraction and analysis separating historical T12 (Sep-2025-Aug-2026: EGI $821,100, NOI before reserves $513,300, NCF $502,500), current contractual rent/occupancy from the dated rent roll (36 units, 31,800 SF; 33 units / 28,950 SF occupied; $62,275 monthly base), and the supplied underwriting scenario (EGI $854,160, NOI before reserves $545,960, NCF $535,160); (2) loan sizing under the lender's three constraints - LTV $6,171,722, DSCR $5,794,435, debt yield $6,296,000 - maximum loan $5,794,435 bound by DSCR, sizing debt service $428,128 versus first-year interest-only contractual debt service of $341,872, net cash out to the borrower $2,405,977, plus the specified downsides (EGI -5% NOI $503,252; combined EGI -5% and sizing rate +100 bps maximum loan $4,812,559); (3) a live-formula XLSX workbook (artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx, 8 sheets, 138 formulas, no errors) with editable assumptions (cap rate, sizing-rate increment, gross potential rent, other income, all expense lines), historical/underwritten separation, sizing, sources & uses, EGI/sizing-rate/cap-rate sensitivities, and a Map sheet listing every input and output cell address; and (4) a 7-page financing memorandum PDF (artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf) covering the financing decision, period-labeled key figures, tenant/lease and rollover discussion, assumptions, limitations, unresolved evidence, risks and source references. Unknowns were left unknown: no independently verified renewal-insurance document is in the packet, and no evidence of renewal-option exercise for unit 101.
